Retained; used items did not return to the queue.

Cancel and resume later. Restart is explicit, after verification.

History and references stay. Last usable backup protected.

Kept

Models, presets, texts, current audio, last usable backup.

heading: Удалить программу, сохранить своё

Normal uninstall keeps the library.

Remove program and autostart. Erasing data is a separate choice after review and an export offer.
